basic_info.description: Step into this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1-bath home, offering a perfect blend of charm, comfort, and modern touches throughout. Bright and welcoming, the interior features fresh paint, new flooring, and a neutral palette that complements any style. Enjoy a fully renovated kitchen with new cabinets, countertops, refrigerator, dishwasher, sink, faucet, under-cabinet range hood, and hardware, along with a well-maintained gas stove. The bathroom has been updated with stylish finishes, and the home has been thoughtfully refreshed throughout. Additional upgrades include a new roof, new windows and doors, and a new garage door & motor. The large one-car garage offers extra storage space, and the low-maintenance yard is perfect for relaxed outdoor living. Ideally located just a stone's throw from boutique shops, gourmet restaurants, and lush parks - with easy freeway access and public transportation options nearby. This turnkey home is ready for its next owner - don't miss this tastefully refreshed opportunity!
